name: CubeSandbox
description: Runs self-hosted, KVM-isolated sandboxes for agent code execution behind an E2B-compatible API, with snapshots, cloning, auto-pause, and kernel-level network policy.

skills.name: E2B-Compatible API
skills.description: Accepts E2B SDK calls so existing E2B clients switch to a self-hosted cluster by changing one environment variable.

skills.name: Snapshot Clone Rollback
skills.description: Checkpoints running sandboxes with the CubeCoW copy-on-write engine, then rolls back to or forks from any saved state.

skills.name: Network Policy And Vault
skills.description: Filters egress per sandbox with eBPF and an L7 proxy that injects credentials, so API keys never enter the sandbox.

skills.name: Auto Pause And Resume
skills.description: Suspends idle sandboxes and wakes them on the next request, with cross-node pause and resume through an S3 backend.

skills.name: Volume Framework
skills.description: Mounts E2B-compatible volumes with pluggable storage backends that live independently and can be shared across sandboxes.
